text_block_list.text:
A few days after showing a lost Oguri Cap the way,
I spotted her wandering the academy grounds with a troubled look once again...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmh... I have ended up back here again...
choice_data_list: Where are you trying to go today?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You are... from the other day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, but could you give me directions again?
I want to go to the training track.
I escorted Oguri Cap to the track.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, there ya are, Oguri! Well look at you!
Ya finally managed to memorize the way to the track, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I was worried ya'd get lost, but I can't be holding yer hand
every time. Guess playin' the tough guy paid off after—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I figured out the way.
Because the Trainer guided me the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So ya just had someone bring ya here after all, ya big goof!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...W-Well, whatever.
Let's get right down to our mock race, then!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let us. I will go get ready.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright, me too!

Oguri Cap's opponent for the mock race was
Tamamo Cross, a formidable horsegirl who had already made her debut.
Word of the matchup spread across the academy in no time—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo-senpai and that transfer student
are about to have a mock race over there right now!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Really?! We finally get to see what Oguri Cap-san
can do up close~! Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmh...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It is awfully noisy.
Is there a festival about to start here?
choice_data_list: I think everyone came to watch you two race.
They're all here to watch your race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Is that so?
To have this many other horsegirls gather...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmm...
choice_data_list: Why are you fidgeting like that?
Why are you fidgeting like that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just... back home, I was never
surrounded by so many people around my age...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I guess I'm not used to it... It makes me feel restless.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's the same during mealtimes... When I pile my plate high with food,
people can't help but stare...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm not fond of that, so lately I've been eating in my room—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aight, sorry to keep ya waitin', Oguri!
I'm good an' ready to—...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hold up?! What's with this massive crowd?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tama...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter, Oguri, ya nervous?
Ya'll never survive a GⅠ lookin' like that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, if yer gettin' stage fright,
just picture all their faces as takoyaki!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Takoyaki"... I see. Understood.
I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ..................Now I've gone and made myself hungry.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-Yer a real piece of work, ya know that...?

And so, the mock race between Oguri Cap
and Tamamo Cross was finally underway...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Lemme show ya what pure Naniwa grit looks like—!!

The distance is 800 meters. Their powerful strides gouge the turf.
Neither gives a single inch...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri...! Heh, the real race starts now!!
The two trade the lead back and forth, over and over, until—!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *whew*...! A dead heat with the exact
same time, huh...? Not bad at all, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama... you're fast, too. Even faster than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you bet I am! But next time,
I'm gonna blow right past yer expectations.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! Now I'm all fired up!
Think I'll go do some roadwork. Catch ya later, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: Great work out there. That was a wonderful race.
Great work out there. That was a wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah... You were watching?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. I've always had a pretty strong heart,
so usually my pulse settles right down after a race...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Right now... it's still pounding fast.
Whenever I think back to our race just now, my heart won't stop racing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's so strange... yet it feels wonderful.
Could this be... what excitement feels like...?
choice_data_list: Sounds like you found yourself a great rival.
Sounds like you found yourself a great rival.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A rival...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see. So this is what the Central—

Oguri Cap lingered where she stood for a long time,
as if trying to hold on to every last bit of that sensation...
